items.what: 쿼리 클러스터링으로 대표 beacon query를 유지하여 장문 추론의 KV cache를 훈련 없이 압축
items.relation: KV cache 압축이라는 같은 최적화 문제를 다루지만, 긴 추론 트레이스에서의 주의 재방문 패턴이 우리의 0.5-4K 프롬프트 설정과는 다른 시나리오
hypothesis_notes: H3: 상위 절반 레이어의 KV를 xk에서 직접 산출하면 prefill FLOPs가 ~48 % 감소
items.title: BeaconKV: Key-Value Cache Compression Guided by Beacon Queries for Efficient Large Reasoning Model Inference
items.abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) achieve superior problem-solving through extended Chain-of-Thought (CoT) generation, but the resulting key-value (KV) cache grows linearly with sequence length and creates severe memory bottlenecks, often exceeding GPU capacity for long reasoning traces. Existing KV cache compression methods rely on recent queries to estimate future token importance, implicitly assuming these serve as reliable proxies for future attention patterns. We demonstrate that this assumption fails in long-horizon reasoning: certain decoding steps generate Thought Revisiting Tokens (TRT) t

items.what: 저비트 KV cache 양자화 손실을 low-rank 적응으로 회복하고 incremental cache 품질 유지
items.relation: KV cache 최적화 기법이지만 autoregressive decoding 단계의 메모리 절감이 주 목표이며, 우리의 prefill TTFT 최적화와는 다른 phase
items.gap: Autoregressive decoding 및 incremental cache(우리는 prefill-only)
items.title: Quality Recovery for Quantized KV Caches via Low-Rank Attention Adaptation
items.abstract: Low-bit key--value (KV) caches reduce the memory required for autoregressive decoding, but the resulting quality loss depends on the model and quantizer. We keep the quantizer fixed and distill the floating-cache model's behavior into low-rank Q/K/V projection updates while the student executes a physically packed incremental cache. Across three seeds, 4-bit affine-cache adapters recover $54.24\%\pm2.47\%$ of the held-out perplexity gap on TinyLlama-1.1B and $75.96\%\pm4.04\%$ on Gemma-4-12B. On the same frozen NF4 Llama-3.1-8B base, one validation-selected run per quantizer recovers $60.42\%$
